# Adrian Watkins
# https://adrianwatkins.com
# Last updated 2026-09-10

> Adrian Watkins is a Singapore-based commercial and operating leader. He is SVP Commercial Operations and Governance at SQREEM Technologies, with additional responsibilities as the Data Protection Officer (DPO). His work spans growth, integration and governance across regional and global markets.

## Framework and platform

- EDGE, created by Adrian Watkins, is a business framework for clearer thinking, better decisions and effective execution: Evaluate, Define, Govern and Elevate. Start at Evaluate for the full sequence; enter any pillar for a specific need. Human judgement remains central.
- EDGE tools are hosted at https://democratising.ai/tools.
- DARE stands for Data, AI, Research and Execution. DARE by democratising.ai is Adrian's shared publishing and data platform supporting publications, data services and practical tools.

- [Writing](https://adrianwatkins.com/writing): essays and perspectives across Asia and globally
- [Friday Frame](https://adrianwatkins.com/writing/friday-frame): weekly reflections
- [Now](https://adrianwatkins.com/now): current work, reading and interests
- [Contact](https://adrianwatkins.com/contact): executive, non-executive director and advisory conversations; pro bono mentoring and student programmes
